_about: ETHERION 카드 일러스트 프롬프트의 원본(등급 · 레벨 · 깃발 · 진영 · 종류). 여기를 고치면 node tools/art/build_prompts.js 를 다시 돌린다. 문구를 바꿨으면 version을 올린다(g1 → g2) — art_map.csv가 옛 버전으로 그린 그림을 알려 준다. 설명은 tools/art/PROMPT_GUIDE.md.
base: Dark fantasy trading card illustration for the card game ETHERION, painterly digital painting, rich brushwork, dramatic lighting, theme: night sky and golden runes.
quality: Quality floor for every grade: a finished, professional card illustration — carefully rendered face, hands, materials and lighting, a character with personality caught in a clear action or story moment, a real sense of place. Higher grades add scale, spectacle and ornament, never more care.
composition: Composition: one main subject centred within the middle 70%; keep the top 15% (card name) and bottom 20% (numbers) calm and dark; edges may be cropped; portrait 4:5.
notext: No text, no letters, no readable runes, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no card frame, no border, no UI.
avoid: Avoid: bright or white background, thick cartoon outlines, photorealism, 3D render look, cute chibi style, anime fan-service, gore, likeness of real people or of characters from other games or films.
accentRule: the element colour stays the main light; the grade accent is a secondary touch (about {share} of the light)
spectacleRule: Each grade is one clear step more spectacular than the grade below (common → superior → rare → epic → unique → special); never more spectacular than the grade above.

token.idea_ko: 마법이나 능력으로 잠깐 불려 나온 것. 작고 덧없지만 그림은 공들여 — 불려 나온 흔적(흩어지는 에테르 · 원소 빛)이 아름답게 보이게.
token.tag: SUMMONED TOKEN — a conjured, temporary creature or effect
token.presence: a creature, construct or effect called into being for a moment; simple and readable
token.camera: eye-level medium shot, subject about 50% of the frame
token.lighting: an element-coloured glow from the summoning with a clean rim light, clear readable contrast
token.background: plain dark night-blue with a fading wisp of ether and element light where it was called forth
token.detail: clear, well-rendered forms with slightly translucent, glowing edges where it was conjured
token.unit: the summoned creature itself, just materialised

common.idea_ko: 그 깃발의 평범한 구성원 · 흔한 마법 · 손때 묻은 물건. 완성도는 다른 등급과 같다 — 얼굴 · 손 · 재질 · 빛을 공들여 그리고, 성격이 보이는 표정과 분명한 동작, 그 깃발 세상의 한 구석이 실제로 보이는 배경. 다른 점은 규모뿐: 몸집이 작고, 배경이 가깝고 아담하며, 신비한 장식 · 등급 강조색이 없다.
common.presence: an ordinary member of the banner caught in a vivid moment of their work — characterful, believable and beautifully painted; smaller in scale than higher grades, never less finished
common.camera: eye-level or slightly low medium shot, natural expressive pose with a clear action, subject about 55% of the frame
common.lighting: a warm, atmospheric element-coloured backlight with a clean rim light and a soft key light on the face, clear readable contrast
common.background: an intimate, painted corner of the banner's world ({hint}) with real atmosphere and soft depth, kept darker and softer than the subject; no distant landmarks
common.detail: fully rendered, believable gear with wear, stitching, dents and soot — practical rather than ornate; expressive face and hands
common.spectacle: none beyond the element glow — no magical ornaments, no aura, no floating particles
common.spell: a single clean, beautifully rendered effect on one or two targets, small in scale but vivid, with layered light and particles
common.item: a used, practical object rendered with loving detail (wear, scratches, stitching), resting on dark stone or cloth, warm low light

uncommon.idea_ko: 검증된 베테랑 · 잘 만든 물건. 일반보다 장비가 좋고 자세가 자신 있다. 고향의 한 조각이 흐릿하게 보이고, 장식 끝에 따뜻한 금빛이 조금.
uncommon.tag: SUPERIOR — a proven veteran, clearly a cut above
uncommon.presence: a seasoned veteran or a well-made thing, better equipped and more confident than the common rank
uncommon.camera: slightly low angle, medium to cowboy shot, confident readied pose, subject about 60% of the frame
uncommon.lighting: element backlight plus a warm key light, clearer rim light, a few glints on metal and edges
uncommon.background: a recognisable slice of the banner's home ({home}) with atmosphere and depth, softly focused, light atmospheric particles
uncommon.detail: fully rendered, better-crafted gear with engraved trim and one personal touch (trophy, badge, charm); expressive face and hands
uncommon.accent: a few small warm gold (#f2cf3d) highlights on trims and edges
uncommon.spectacle: a few glints on metal and a light haze of atmospheric particles — one small step above common
uncommon.spell: a stronger effect with visible flow and a second layer of particles
uncommon.item: a well-crafted object on a workbench or simple stand, gold-tinted trim catching the light

rare.idea_ko: 정예 · 걸작. 팩에서 나오면 눈이 가는 카드. 역동적인 구도, 깊이 있는 배경에 고향의 랜드마크 하나, 사파이어빛 에테르 알갱이와 얇은 테두리 빛.
rare.tag: RARE — an elite specialist or a masterwork, the card people notice
rare.presence: an elite with a signature move, or a masterwork — clearly special
rare.camera: dynamic three-quarter low angle, action pose or poised decisive moment, strong diagonal, subject about 65% of the frame
rare.lighting: dramatic: strong element backlight plus a cool sapphire rim light, volumetric haze, sparkling highlights
rare.background: atmospheric environment in depth layers (foreground debris, midground, far distance) with one landmark of the banner's home: {landmark}
rare.detail: fine filigree and engraved patterns on gear, crisp material rendering (metal, scale, cloth, bark, horn)
rare.accent: drifting sapphire-blue (#4ea8ff) ether motes and a thin sapphire rim on the silhouette
rare.spectacle: drifting ether motes, a crisp rim light, volumetric haze and sparkling highlights — clearly a step above superior
rare.spell: a sweeping effect that reshapes part of the battlefield, layered energies and motion trails
rare.item: a masterwork object on a carved pedestal, faint glowing engraved patterns, small floating particles

upgrade.idea_ko: 원래 카드 3장을 합쳐 한 단계 오른 같은 인물. 원래 카드 그림이 있으면 참고 그림으로 넣어 같은 얼굴 · 종족 · 색을 지키고, 장비가 보강되고 셋이 하나가 된 표시(세 줄 띠 · 보석 셋 · 세 겹)와 아래에서 솟는 청록 에너지.
upgrade.tag: EMPOWERED — the same warrior fused from three into one stronger self
upgrade.presence: the base card's unit evolved: three of the same warrior fused into one stronger self — same identity, visibly reinforced
upgrade.camera: the same framing as the base card but one step closer and lower, a rising, upward pose
upgrade.lighting: element backlight plus teal energy pouring up from below and glowing through seams of the gear
upgrade.background: the same setting as the base card, intensified: more particles and a faint shockwave ring ({home})
upgrade.detail: reinforced, upgraded gear (an extra plate, a heavier weapon, a bigger device) with a triple motif: three bands, three gems, three barrels or three braids fused into one
upgrade.accent: teal (#3fe0c0) energy seams and upward-streaming light streaks, a flowing sheen
upgrade.spectacle: teal energy rising from below, glowing seams and a faint shockwave ring — between rare and epic
upgrade.reference: If a reference image is attached, it is the base card ({base}): keep the same character, species, face, colours and silhouette and repaint it as the empowered version.

epic.idea_ko: 영웅 · 괴물 · 초월자의 유물. 영화의 한 장면처럼 크고 강하다. 낮은 광각, 빛줄기, 날씨와 전장의 이야기, 보랏빛 비술 알갱이.
epic.tag: EPIC — heroic and larger than life, cinematic
epic.presence: a heroic, larger-than-life figure, monster or relic whose power bends the whole scene around it
epic.camera: cinematic low wide angle, heroic pose at the peak of action, scale cues (tiny figures, broken walls, huge debris), subject about 70% of the frame with environment
epic.lighting: high-contrast cinematic lighting, volumetric god rays in the element colour, glowing eyes or weapon, soft bloom
epic.background: rich environmental storytelling: {landmark}; weather (storm, ash, spray, wind) and deep atmosphere
epic.detail: ornate, layered armour or garments, battle wear, magical energy wrapping the body
epic.accent: violet (#b46cff) arcane particles and a faint violet edge to the aura
epic.spectacle: cinematic: volumetric god rays, an energy aura wrapping the body, weather, flying debris and soft bloom — a step above rare
epic.spell: a cataclysmic spell at full force — vortex, shockwave or impact crater — with the battlefield reacting
epic.item: a relic of a transcendent being floating in its own aura above a ruined altar, radiating its element

unique.idea_ko: 그 깃발의 이름난 전설(덱에 1장). 포스터에 걸 만한 상징적 초상. 가운데 영웅 구도, 뒤에 그 깃발의 근원(거인 · 용 · 신)이 거대한 실루엣으로, 녹은 주황 금빛 불티와 금 세공.
unique.tag: UNIQUE — a named legend of the banner, iconic hero portrait
unique.presence: a named legend of this banner — iconic and instantly recognisable, a hero image you would hang as a poster
unique.camera: centred heroic portrait, near-symmetrical, subject about 70% of the frame, looking slightly down toward the viewer, a strong iconic silhouette
unique.lighting: masterful chiaroscuro, a halo-like element backlight behind head and shoulders, molten orange-gold rim light
unique.background: {landmark}; behind it, faint and colossal, the banner's source: {source}
unique.detail: masterwork: heraldic ornaments of the banner, a signature personal weapon or relic, rich textures, gold inlay
unique.accent: molten orange-gold (#ff8a2a) embers and rim light, fine gold filigree
unique.spectacle: iconic: a halo-like backlight, swirling embers, gleaming gold filigree and the faint colossal silhouette of the banner's source behind — a step above epic
unique.spell: a legendary spell bearing the banner's source's mark, framed like an icon
unique.item: a legendary relic displayed like a treasure, the banner's source looming faintly behind

special.idea_ko: 최고 등급. 깃발마다 하나뿐인 신화적 존재(승천자 · 깨어난 기계 · 걸어 다니는 숲 · 용의 노래 …)와 삼좌의 유물. 깃발에서 가장 중요한 그림, 키 아트 급. 깃발의 평범한 구성원(고블린 · 오크 · 마족 …)으로 그리지 않는다 — 제 힘으로 이루어진 몸(불 · 쇠 · 바위 · 물 · 그림자 · 빛 · 별빛)을 가진 하나뿐인 존재. 요새 · 군대 · 용과 견줄 만큼 크고, 같은 깃발의 에픽 · 유니크보다 확실히 강하고 웅장해 보여야 한다. 세계 크기의 배경(하늘을 채운 근원 존재), 금빛 룬 고리 여러 겹, 하늘을 가르는 빛기둥, 진홍 · 금의 신성한 빛. 몸 전체를 다 보여 주지 않고 연기 · 빛 · 어둠에 반쯤 가려 배경과 주변의 반응으로 크기를 상상하게 해도 된다.
special.tag: SPECIAL — the highest grade: mythic, a one-of-a-kind being of the world or a relic of the Three Thrones, key-art quality
special.presence: mythic: a one-of-a-kind being, one of the great powers of the world and never an ordinary member of any race, or a relic of the Three Thrones — the single most important image of its banner; it must look clearly stronger and grander than any epic or unique card of the same banner
special.camera: monumental worm's-eye angle, epic scale — the subject towers and fills about 75–85% of the frame against a world-sized backdrop, with scale cues (fortresses, armies, dragons or mountains look small beside it); light may spill to the margins but the face or heart and the core stay in the safe area
special.lighting: divine and overwhelming: a radiant crimson-and-gold aura, light bursting from the subject itself, rays falling from above, the element light at full intensity
special.background: world-scale: {mythic}; the land and sky visibly bending and reacting to the subject; the night sky opening with stars and golden rune circles; a faint empty circle (the sigil of the lost source-god Arche) as a halo ring
special.detail: transcendent: a body made of its own power (fire, iron, stone, water, shadow, light or starlight), unlike any ordinary race; intricate gold filigree, cathedral-level detail
special.accent: crimson-rose (#ff4d73) and gold divine light that may rival the element light, slowly turning golden rune circles, ether sky-blue (#8fdcff) sparks
special.spectacle: the most spectacular grade, clearly beyond unique: several orbiting golden rune rings at different angles, a pillar of light splitting the sky, a radiant crimson-and-gold aura, storms of embers and ether sparks, the ground and sky reacting to its presence, layered depth in front of and behind the subject
special.technique: the being may be partly veiled — half-hidden in smoke, light, storm or darkness, revealed by glimpses (an eye, a hand, a silhouette, a heart of light), so the viewer imagines the full colossal shape from those clues and from how the world reacts around it
special.unit: A one-of-a-kind mythic being — never drawn as an ordinary member of any race
special.item: a sacred relic suspended in a pillar of divine light inside a ring of golden runes, an empty circle behind it, the world tiny below

unit.1: small and humble: an ordinary body, light gear
unit.3: seasoned: a sturdier body, a bigger weapon, mount or machine
unit.5: elite and imposing: a large silhouette, heavy gear or a big creature or machine; the scene starts to react to it
unit.7: towering and awe-inspiring: huge scale (giant creature, siege engine, archmage); the environment visibly bends to its power
unit.8: mythic and colossal, far beyond mortal scale: it towers over fortresses, armies or even dragons, the land cracks and bends around it and lesser creatures look tiny; its presence fills the sky

spell.3: an effect over a few targets

item.3: a fine object with a faint aura
item.5: a powerful object with a strong aura
item.7: an ancient object of great power

brass.text: Adamant Concord: copper, brass, steam, soot, gears, furnaces; they mine black adamant from the bodies of sleeping giants. No gods — technology instead

verdant.text: Verdant Covenant: ancient forests, moss, grassland, lagoons, songs; power borrowed through pacts with dragons

arcane.text: Arcane Conclave: white citadels, stars, spires, magic circles, canyons of shadow; power received from gods, always for a price

metal.cue: cold steel sheen, sparks from an anvil, rivets

earth.cue: flying rock dust, cracked ground, ochre light

forest.cue: glowing moss, thorny vines, drifting leaves

water.cue: clear water light, spray, ripples, bubbles

dark.cue: violet shadow smoke, blood-red accents, contract sigils

light.cue: pale gold radiance, halo, feathers of light

wind.cue: swirling teal wind, fluttering robes and pages

B1.who: goblins (and a few humans) of the gunpowder artillery corps: small wiry bodies, huge pointed ears, sharp grins, soot-smeared faces, goggles pushed up
B1.silhouette: a small figure dwarfed by an oversized cannon, musket or powder keg
B1.materials: scorched leather aprons, brass and blackened iron, bandoliers of cartridges, fuse cords, riveted gun carriages
B1.palette: fire orange #ff6b3d with brass #d4893a and soot black
B1.motifs: cannons, matchlock muskets, powder kegs, lit fuses, mortar shells, smoke plumes, sparks
B1.home: the fortress-foundry of Fortan, chimneys and gun bastions
B1.landmark: Fortan's chimneys and gun bastions on volcanic slopes, the Crown range volcanoes glowing beyond
B1.source: the sleeping giant Dormak, whose heart-fire burns inside the volcano like a colossal ember in a mountain-sized chest
B1.mythic: the giant Dormak's mountain-sized chest with its heart-fire blazing through cracks of rock across the whole sky
B1.light: flashes of cannon fire and glowing embers inside thick gunpowder smoke
B1.never: no magic circles or spellcasting (their fire is gunpowder and engineering), no elegant armour, no dwarven greatswords

B2.who: stocky dwarves with braided iron-grey beards, and the riveted golems and automatons they forge
B2.silhouette: broad, square and heavy — a walking wall of riveted steel
B2.materials: thick steel plate, rivets, grey adamant (petrified giant bone), chains, forge hammers, glowing forge seams
B2.palette: steel grey #a9b4c2, gunmetal, brass, molten forge orange inside the seams
B2.motifs: forge hammers, anvils, riveted golems, piston joints, gears, stamped steel crests, shield walls
B2.hint: a riveted iron gate in a dim forge hall
B2.landmark: the colossal underground halls of Durkheim with lava channels, mine shafts and iron gates, glowing ore veins like sinews in the rock
B2.source: the sleeping giant Sorgrim, whose iron sinews form the Ironbone mountains, watched by the mirror-scaled metal dragon Feros
B2.mythic: the giant Sorgrim's mountain-sized arm of iron sinew rising from the earth, and the metal dragon Feros's mirror scales reflecting a thousand forges
B2.light: cold steel sheen against molten forge glow, sparks from the anvil
B2.never: no thorns or plant armour, no wizardry or wands; golems are machines, not undead

B3.who: tiny clever gnome scholars and engineers: big noses, wild hair, brass goggles, lab coats with many pockets
B3.silhouette: a tiny figure beside big contraptions — coils, lightning towers, walking machines
B3.materials: copper coils, glass jars of captured lightning, brass gauges, insulated cables, lab glass, leather straps
B3.palette: electric yellow #ffd84a with copper, cobalt-blue sparks and dark brass
B3.motifs: lightning jars, copper coils, lightning-rod towers, dials and gauges, arcs leaping between electrodes, blueprints
B3.hint: a cluttered workshop bench with coils
B3.home: the lightning-rod city of Voltarium on the thundering plateau
B3.landmark: the spiked lightning-rod towers of Voltarium crowned by a lightning storm
B3.source: the sleeping giant Keraun, whose lightning nerves branch through the ground like a vast glowing circuit
B3.mythic: the giant Keraun's lightning nerves blazing across the whole plateau and sky like a living circuit board of storms
B3.light: harsh flickering arc light and crackling electricity
B3.never: no mystical magic or wands — their power is science and machines

G1.who: powerful orc warriors: huge fists, tusks, scarred grey-green skin, war paint, braided hair
G1.silhouette: massive shoulders and oversized fists; riders on giant wolves or bears
G1.materials: rough leather, furs, bone ornaments, stone- and obsidian-studded gauntlets, rope, wooden totems
G1.palette: earth ochre #b88a5a, rust-red war paint, bone white
G1.motifs: giant fists, wolves and bears, bone trinkets, totems, war drums, cracked ground, dust clouds
G1.hint: tall dry grass and a hide tent
G1.home: the howling steppe of Garun with its nomad camps
G1.landmark: the endless howling steppe of Garun with standing stones, nomad camps and a stone duel ring
G1.source: the earth dragon Gorbas, the largest of the seven dragons, with rocks and forests growing on its back
G1.mythic: the earth dragon Gorbas, mountain-sized with forests on its back, rising behind Throne Peak with one great eye opening
G1.light: dusty ochre light and rock dust hanging in the air
G1.never: no high-tech machinery, no elegant plate armour, no magic circles (shamans use drums, bones and earth)

G2.who: tall moss trolls with long, lanky, moss-covered limbs, and treants (living trees)
G2.silhouette: tall, hunched and long-armed; treants tower like ancient trees
G2.materials: bark armour, moss, thorns, vines, roots, mushrooms, amber sap
G2.palette: forest green #58b85f, deep moss, bark brown, bioluminescent spores
G2.motifs: thorns and briars, vines, regrowing limbs, glowing moss, seeds, giant roots
G2.home: the giant-tree city of Sylvaniel in the great forest of Eilen
G2.landmark: the colossal trunks and hanging bridges of Sylvaniel around the First Elder Tree, in mist
G2.source: the forest dragon Verdan, with antlers of ancient tree branches and moss-covered scales
G2.mythic: the forest dragon Verdan's antlers spreading as a canopy of ancient branches over the whole forest, the First Elder Tree glowing beneath
G2.light: dappled green light through the canopy and glowing spores
G2.never: no elves (elves belong to the Storm High Elves), no fire magic, no huge humanoid 'giants' (the giants are the land itself)

G3.who: merfolk with blue scales and flowing fins, water spirits, and the shrine maidens of the Spring Choir
G3.silhouette: graceful flowing curves; long hair and fins drifting like silk
G3.materials: blue scales, pearls, coral, shells, translucent fins, flowing silk shrine robes, harpoons
G3.palette: water blue #4fb3ff, aquamarine, pearl white, deep-sea navy
G3.motifs: water spirals, song shown as rippling rings, pearls, coral shields, harpoons, waves, bubbles
G3.landmark: the pillars of the Selenea temple rising from a moonlit lagoon, waves and spray
G3.source: the water dragon Marencia, a long translucent body with fins instead of wings
G3.mythic: the water dragon Marencia's translucent serpentine body coiling through the sky like a river of light
G3.light: caustic underwater light and shimmering reflections
G3.never: no fire, no heavy plate armour

A1.who: demon contractors: curved horns, ashen or pale skin, glowing eyes, elegant dark attire
A1.silhouette: tall, sharp and elegant: curved horns, tattered capes, long blades or scythes
A1.materials: black silk, dark lacquered armour, chains, contract scrolls sealed with blood wax, bone, obsidian
A1.motifs: blood-signed contracts, scales of judgment, closed eyes, sigils, shadow smoke, chains, scythes
A1.home: the shadow city of Noctar in a sunless canyon
A1.landmark: the spires of Noctar carved into the walls of a sunless canyon, lit only by violet lanterns
A1.source: the god Morkas, the Silent Lord — a faceless shadow king holding balanced scales, eyes closed
A1.mythic: the faceless shadow king Morkas towering across the sky with his balanced scales, eyes closed
A1.light: cold violet underlight, blood-red glints, deep shadows
A1.never: no holy light, no crude cartoon devils — they are elegant and ominous

A2.who: seraphs with white feathered wings and halos, and human knights of the Radiant Order
A2.silhouette: upright and protective; wings spread wide behind great shields
A2.materials: white and gold plate armour, white feathers, tabards, great tower shields, lances, sun emblems
A2.palette: holy light #ffe9a8, white, pale gold, soft sky blue
A2.motifs: halos, wings, great shields, a rising sun with a sword, feathers of light, oaths
A2.home: the white walls of the Dawn Citadel Elad
A2.landmark: the white walls and towers of the Dawn Citadel Elad at sunrise, banners in the wind; the Twilight Wall facing the void lands
A2.source: the goddess Solante, Mother of Dawn — a radiant woman with six wings of light
A2.mythic: the goddess Solante's six vast wings of light spread across the whole sky above a rising sun
A2.light: warm radiant backlight and sunrise glow
A2.never: no demonic elements, no gore; they are defenders, so attacks look restrained and righteous

A3.who: high-elf mages: long pointed ears, silver hair, slender and proud
A3.silhouette: slender figures whose robes and hair are swept by strong wind, book pages flying around them
A3.materials: flowing silver-white and teal robes with star embroidery, open spellbooks, crystal staffs, scrolls
A3.palette: wind teal #9fe3d6, silver, white, starry indigo
A3.motifs: swirling wind, flying pages, abstract star glyphs, constellations, spire towers, feathers
A3.home: the cloud-piercing spire towers of Belumir's Needle
A3.landmark: the spires of Belumir's Needle piercing the clouds under a night sky full of stars
A3.source: the god Belumir, the Star-Reader — a robe with a thousand eyes, an open book and stars
A3.mythic: the god Belumir's robe of a thousand eyes unfolding across the night sky as constellations
A3.light: cool teal-white starlight and streaks of wind
A3.never: no forest elves or nature druids, no bulky muscles; star glyphs are abstract shapes, never readable letters

classes.무장: an armed fighter wielding a weapon typical of the banner
classes.무도: a close-combat brawler, beast or living war machine — bare fists, claws, horns or sheer armoured bulk
classes.기도: a devoted priest, ritualist or pact-bound servant, praying or offering

types.unit: a character card: upper body to full body, pose fits its role
types.atk: attack spell — the instant of impact: aggressive diagonal composition, the force travels toward the enemy (shown as dark silhouettes); the caster, if shown, is small
types.def: defense spell — protection forming: stable, symmetrical composition, a barrier, ward or wings around allies, incoming harm deflected
types.any: versatile spell — a dual effect: a balanced composition with power flowing in two directions
types.hand: trick spell played on the opponent's hidden hand — cunning: hidden cards, eyes, threads of fate, a sly hand in shadow; quieter, mysterious lighting
types.item: a single object, centred and shown whole, no hands and no person holding it; lit by faded old-gold light plus the element glow
